title: Two surveyed sections of the German Autobahn A9, in ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.4

criterion.says: a road this tree derives from OpenStreetMap is measured against the SURVEYED reference line, lane widths, gradient and superelevation of the same kilometres of the A9, in ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.4 -- a measurement carried further than any derivation, so the corpus can never be the thing that is wrong

source.pinReason: the survey of 2017-04-04 was published once; the Mobilithek migration broke the MDM download and TUM's geoinformatics chair mirrors the files, licence PDF included, so the mirror's commit is the pin
